market-equilibrium-shortage.alt: A supply and demand graph for lemonade with equilibrium E at $3; at a price of $2, quantity demanded (70 cups) exceeds quantity supplied (40 cups), a shortage of 30 cups.

market-equilibrium-double-shift.alt: Two supply and demand graphs where both curves shift: when both increase, quantity rises but the price change is indeterminate; when demand rises and supply falls, price rises but the quantity change is indeterminate.
